CITY OF SAN MARINO

  CITY COUNCIL AGENDA

Susan Jakubowski, Mayor  www.cityofsanmarino.org
Steve Talt, Vice Mayor  (626) 300-0700 Phone
Steven W. Huang, DDS, Council Member  (626) 300-0709 Fax
Gretchen Shepherd Romey, Council Member  City Hall Council Chamber
Ken Ude, Council Member  2200 Huntington Drive
Marcella Marlowe, Ph.D., City Manager  San Marino, CA 91108

  ADJOURNED MEETING
  OF THE SAN MARINO CITY COUNCIL
  FRIDAY, MARCH 25, 2022 AT 8:30 A.M.
  SAN MARINO CENTER
  1800 HUNTINGTON DRIVE
  SAN MARINO, CA 91108

The City of San Marino appreciates your attendance. Citizens’ interest provides the Council with
valuable information regarding issues of the community.

Regular meetings are held on the 2nd Wednesday of every month at 6:00 p.m. Typically, adjourned
meetings are held on the last Friday of every month at 8:30 a.m.

In compliance with the Americans with Disabilities Act, any person with a disability who requires
a reasonable modification or accommodation in order to participate in a meeting should contact
the City Clerk via email at cityclerk@cityofsanmarino.org or by phone at (626) 300-0705 prior
to the meeting for assistance.

  PURSUANT TO ASSEMBLY BILL (AB) 361
Members of the City Council may teleconference into the meeting without noticing each
teleconference location from which a member will be participating in a public meeting.

  CORONAVIRUS DISEASE (COVID-19) ADVISORY
To protect both staff, our constituents, and elected officials, it is recommended that members of
the public wear a mask indoors, per the State and County Health Department’s current Health
Officer Orders. Given the seriousness of COVID-19, you are encouraged to provide input
electronically if you do not feel comfortable attending in person.

How to participate in the meeting from home:
  1) Via Computer for Video Streaming:
  Website: https://us02web.zoom.us/j/89129020444
  Meeting ID: 891 2902 0444
  2) Via Phone for Audio Only:
  Phone Number: (669) 900-9128
  Meeting ID: 891 2902 0444
 CITY COUNCIL AGENDA – MARCH 25, 2022  PAGE 2 OF 4

How to offer public comment from home:

  1) Public comment will be accepted by email to cityclerk@cityofsanmarino.org until 3:00
  p.m. the day before the meeting, to be read by the City Clerk during public comment.
  Lengthy public comment may be summarized in the interest of time. Any comments
  received after 3:00 p.m. will be included in the public comment record but will not be
  read at the meeting.
  2) Public comment will be accepted electronically via the zoom.us teleconference module
  during the meeting. Zoom comments will be taken after the in-person comments.

CALL TO ORDER

PLEDGE OF ALLEGIANCE

ROLL CALL:  Council Member Huang, Council Member Shepherd Romey, Council
  Member Ude, Vice Mayor Talt, and Mayor Jakubowski

POSTING OF AGENDA

The agenda is posted 72 hours prior to each regular meeting at the following locations: City Hall,
2200 Huntington Drive, the Crowell Public Library, 1890 Huntington Drive, and the Stoneman
Building, 1560 Pasqualito Drive.  The agenda is also posted on the City’s website:
http://www.cityofsanmarino.org.

PUBLIC COMMENTS

The City welcomes public input. Members of the public may address the City Council by
completing a public comment card and giving it to the City Clerk prior to the meeting. At this
time, the public may address the City Council on items that are not on the agenda. Pursuant to
state law, the City Council may not discuss or take action on issues not on the meeting agenda
(Government Code Section 54954.2). The Mayor reserves the right to place limits on duration
of comments. Staff may be asked to follow up on such items.

MOTION TO WAIVE FURTHER READINGS

This action permits the City Council to act on ordinances and resolutions without having to read
the entire text of the ordinance or resolution. The title of an ordinance on First Reading must
be read in its entirety. An ordinance on Second Reading does not require having the title read.
However, the City Council may request that an ordinance or resolution be read in its entirety
before taking any action.
 CITY COUNCIL AGENDA – MARCH 25, 2022  PAGE 3 OF 4

  NEW BUSINESS

1. REVIEW OF DRAFT FY 2022-23 CAPITAL IMPROVEMENT PLAN AND 5-YEAR
  FORECAST

  Recommendation: Staff recommends that the City Council review the draft FY 2022-23 capital
  construction budget and 5-year capital improvement plan and provide direction and guidance
  on two matters: 1) approve or reject the proposed FY 2022-23 expenditures, and 2) offer
  guidance on any FY 2023-24 or beyond projects that should be moved up into FY 2022-23.

2. APPROVAL OF PURCHASE FROM AAA NETWORK SOLUTIONS FOR A
  CAMERA SURVEILLANCE AND INTERCOM SYSTEM AND APPROPRIATION
  OF $75,023 FROM THE CAPITAL RESERVES

  Recommendation: Staff recommends that the City Council approve the purchase and
  installation of a camera surveillance and intercom system from AAA Network Solutions, solicit
  bids for a security gate, authorize the City Manager to execute contracts for both, and
  appropriate $75,023 to account 394-30-4600-0887 (PD Surveillance System) from the capital
  reserves funds for the work.

3. APPROVAL OF AN INCREASE TO FY 2021-22 AQUATICS PROGRAM
  EXPENDITURE BUDGET APPROPRIATION BY $53,516, AN INCREASE IN
  AQUATICS PROGRAM FEE REVENUES BY $14,568, THE REVISED
  COMMUNITY SERVICES DEPARTMENT FULL TIME EQUIVALENT TOTAL,
  AND AN UPDATE TO THE CITY’S PART TIME SALARY SCHEDULE TO ADD
  TWO CLASSIFICATIONS

  Recommendation: Staff recommends that the City Council (1) reinstate the aquatics section
  of the Community Services Department; (2) approve Resolution No. R-22-14 approving the
  updated 2022 Salary Schedule; and (3) amend the City’s Fiscal Year 2021-22 budget as noted
  in the Staff Report.

4. APPROVAL OF ORDINANCE NO. O-22-1389 (FIRST READING) UPDATING
  CHAPTERS 1.04, 1.06, AND 8.02 REGARDING PUBLIC NUISANCES,
  ADMINISTRATIVE CITATIONS, AND ENFORCEMENT OF CODE
  VIOLATIONS

  Recommendation: Staff recommends that the City Council introduce for first reading by title
  only, and waive further reading Ordinance No. O-22-1389, An Ordinance of the City Council
  of the City of San Marino, California Amending Chapters 1.04, 1.06, and 8.02 Regarding Public
  Nuisances, Administrative Citations, and Enforcement of Code Violations, and direct staff to
  agendize the ordinance for a second reading and possible adoption at the Council’s next
  regular meeting.
 CITY COUNCIL AGENDA – MARCH 25, 2022  PAGE 4 OF 4

5. APPROVAL OF ORDINANCE NO. O-22-1388 (FIRST READING) AMENDING
  CHAPTER 17.02 OF THE CITY CODE REGARDING PROHIBITED ACTIVITIES
  IN LACY PARK, INCLUDING SMOKING

  Recommendation: Staff recommends that the City Council introduce for first reading by title
  only, Ordinance No. O-22-1388, an Ordinance of the City Council of the City of San Marino,
  California Amending Chapter 17.02 of the San Marino Municipal Code Pertaining to
  Restrictions on Activities in Lacy Park, Including Smoking, and direct staff to agendize the
  Ordinance for a second reading and possible adoption at the Council’s next regular meeting.

6. DISCUSSION OF A NON-MONETARY DONATIONS POLICY

  Recommendation: Staff recommends that the City Council provide staff direction on whether
  to formulate a non-monetary donations policy and what the aspects of that policy would be.

  CLOSED SESSION

7. CONFERENCE WITH LABOR NEGOTIATORS
  Government Code Section 54957.6

  City negotiator(s):
  City Manager Marlowe

  Employee Organization(s):
  San Marino Police Officers’ Association
  San Marino Firefighters’ Association
  San Marino City Employees’ Association
  Unrepresented Employees

WRITTEN COMMUNICATIONS OR PUBLIC WRITINGS DISTRIBUTED

This is an opportunity to announce any written communications pertaining to the City received
by members of the City Council. All public writings distributed by the City of San Marino to at
least a majority of the City Council regarding any item on this agenda will be made available at
the Public Counter at City Hall located at 2200 Huntington Drive, San Marino, California 91108,
and will also be included in the public agenda packet that will available for review at the City
Council meeting.

PUBLIC COMMENTS

FUTURE AGENDA ITEMS

ADJOURNMENT

Dated: March 17, 2022  CHRISTINA BAKER
Posted: March 18, 2022  CITY CLERK
